protocol: Source train only; exclude all six validation sites using filename-derived site. Exact validation crop pixels excluded. Median + fixed RBF SVM C10 gamma scale for both models. No hyperparameter tuning.
excluded_training_images: Malurpatna 996CE Kala, Kakkayya, Aiyayya & Tatrapala Herostone With Inscription
limitations: Same 300 validation crops reused; not a fresh final test.
Site groups are conservative filename-derived groups, not verified stone identities.
Broader corpus script/language composition and label conventions remain unaudited.
Source annotation boxes supplied; no automatic segmentation tested.
Recognition labels are raw source transliteration strings.
